accepted_result: Reconstruction of the prior published disproof by Katkova-Shapiro-Vishnyakova (2024). No novelty or priority claim.

public_report.status: Editorial edition of the accepted report; only mapped nonmathematical wording changes and review disclosure.

mathematical_scope.selection: All nonnegative unweighted differences, including zero differences; endpoints use zero-extended coefficients.
mathematical_scope.ratio_sign_qualification: The ratios are positive and below 1; the associated differences are negative.
mathematical_scope.distinct_root_certificate: The table-free D=10^7 perturbation has positive coefficients, 13 distinct simple negative roots, and parity count at most 11.
mathematical_scope.indexing_qualification: Use the actual increasing list starting k_1; the source parity-sequence lower index i=0 is a printing typo, not an extra k_0 term.

source_boundary: The arXiv v1 mathematical pages were inspected during the recorded audit. Journal publication metadata was verified, but the journal-version PDF was not inspected. Packaging performed no new source retrieval or inspection.
